/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'

archives=[]
lines=[]

 digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert digest==item['sha256']
 lines.append(f'{path}: {digest}')
 with tarfile.open(path) as archive:
  archives.append({m.name:archive.extractfile(m).read() for m in archive.getmembers() if m.isfile()})
changed=sorted(k for k in archives[0].keys()|archives[1].keys() if archives[0].get(k)"'!=archives[1].get(k))
assert changed==sorted(x['"'path'] for x in report['archiveChanges'])
lines+=changed
Path('test-results/subsequent-adoption/artifact-verification.log').write_text('\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n')
p=Path('package.json'); data=json.loads(p.read_text())
data['dependencies']['@asyra/preset']='0.5.8-task4.0'
data['resolutions']['@asyra/preset']='file:./artifacts/asyra-preset-0.5.8-task4.0.tgz'
p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\\n')
PY
